correctness.rationale: For all integer m≥2, the disjoint half-open cells P_a=[0,θ/m) in y, P_b=[θ/m,1/m), plus P_j=[j/m,(j+1)/m) for 1≤j<m cover the fundamental square and have finitely many affine boundary pieces. Merging a,b recovers the canonical base-m digits of y; uniform distribution of multiplication-by-m orbits holds simultaneously for all real θ thresholds on one full-measure forward-invariant set Y, so frequency of letter a is θ/m and reconstructs θ. Thus one-sided names separate a full Haar-measure subset. Haar entropy is log m; an s-cell generator must have s≥m. If s=m, equality in H_n≤nlogm and entropy rate inf_n H_n/n=logm forces all n-word distributions uniform; name shift is ergodic Bernoulli, contrary to invariant nonconstant θ factor of T_m. Hence g=g_poly=m+1. The proof is all-m symbolic, not finite trajectory extrapolation.
